data_fields.name: hub_services_mask
data_fields.donor_constant: services bits OR-accumulated from data; default port All, uninhabited OffersMissions

data_fields.name: per_service_condition
data_fields.donor_constant: to service <name> condition set; absent = open to anyone with hub access

data_fields.name: hud_linger
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 frames after a jump ends (comment: 5 s, assumes 60 fps)

best_idea: A hub offers a service only when three checks pass in order (the data bit is set, the player can access the hub, the service's own condition holds), and its menu lists only the services that pass, so a locked service is absent rather than greyed out.
decision_why: Town services (bank, trade, job board, hire crew, missions) that unlock with progress fit the bit-plus-condition shape; the server must run the same check on every spend and read the one ledger; the donor's add-only event step is kept but its condition overwrite on re-load is fixed; the minimap linger is a small HUD fold-in.
acceptance: In a town hub the Bank button and its key are absent until the bank condition holds; a server test refuses a bank action for a player without the condition even when the client sends it; a data event adds a shipyard to the hub and it appears in the menu on the next open.
